english.note: For a transit stop, 站 is the all-purpose Cantonese noun, including a bus, tram, or train stop.

exampleSentences.english: Get off at the next stop.
exampleSentences.jyutping: haa6 jat1 go3 zaam6 lok6 ce1 aa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary public-transport stop or station.

exampleSentences.english: We’ll get off at the next station.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 jat1 go3 zaam6 lok6 ce1
